plugins.name: crbiz-pm
plugins.description: CRBiz PM for Claude Code. PM-as-Configuration-Overlay grammar with reference implementations of the discovery-strategy, tailwind-catalyst-app and zoho-catalyst-app archetypes. Install via marketplace on any surface; slash-command invocation runs in Claude Code CLI on a local folder or a Claude Code remote session against a repo (not currently supported in claude.ai/code Cowork). Bidirectional HTML board with IndexedDB-persistent file access, chip-spawn wrapper with per-chip git worktree allocation, Tie-back protocol, lean PM context. v2.3.0 of the PM-on-CC discipline. New in 2.3.0: multi-project client areas. A client area holds many projects; every skill here assumed one, and the gap was live rather than theoretical — /pm-init in a real five-project area did not refuse, it scaffolded a root docs/ as though the five were one, producing a phantom sixth project the detectors would then report as healthy. One resolver (hooks/pm-project-resolve.sh) implements the decision: refuse for anything that WRITES, span for READ-ONLY. It names every candidate and prints the flag exactly as it must be typed, because the refusal text is part of the decision, not a detail of it — and a contract of that shape is only keepable if one thing emits it, rather than ~25 SKILL.md files drifting apart. /pm-init now requires --project=<slug> in a client area and --new-project to create a directory that does not exist, so a misspelt slug fails closed instead of silently creating a junk project. /pm-lint gains I14, project attribution, which fires only where a repo declares projects: and does not accept entity: as a substitute. Carried from 2.2.0, still a behaviour change on upgrade from 2.1.x: WebFetch moves deny -> ask and WebSearch moves ask -> allow in the scaffold template, because a deny is not liftable by an allow from any source — the tool is withheld from the session toolset entirely, with nothing at session start saying why. 40 skills + 6 agents + SessionStart hook + 2 PreToolUse hooks (git-stage-guard + worktree-visibility-guard); /pm-lint runs 23 checks.

plugins.name: crbiz-skills
plugins.description: CRBiz's own Claude skills for Zoho consulting. An L0 foundation — platform mechanics (OAuth, data centres, API credits), the Deluge language, the product catalogue and persona-based licensing architecture — under six L1 product specialists: CRM on API v8 (Composite, Bulk, COQL, GraphQL, Notification), Desk, Analytics, Catalyst, Field Service Management, and the finance suite (Books, Invoice, Billing, Inventory, Expense, Payroll). Each specialist keeps judgement in SKILL.md, depth in references/, and carries a dated source note recording what was verified, against which documentation, and what could not be — so a stale fact is visible rather than inferred. Also ships BRD/PRD elicitation, WordPress and SEO migration, and finance and mail administration. Working conventions ship as a SessionStart hook so language and output format are right in the first reply rather than after a skill happens to trigger. Identity, agent-to-agent escalation, BAU and bug structure, and client-area layout are owned by the Global PM BRD and referenced, never restated. 18 skills + 1 agent + SessionStart hook + a six-check validation harness.
